page_title: The #1 AI Resume Builder – Forbes' Top Pick. Trusted by 4.8M

summary.name: Rezi
summary.one_liner: Rezi is an AI resume builder that helps users write, tailor, score and optimize ATS-friendly resumes against job descriptions.
use_cases: Writing a resume tailored to a specific job posting
Checking a resume for ATS compatibility and missing keywords
Generating resume bullet points and summaries
Creating cover letters and resignation letters
Practicing job interview questions based on your resume
Searching for open jobs and tracking applications
summary.what_it_does: Rezi is a web-based resume builder that uses AI to create and edit resumes. Users can upload an existing resume or start from scratch, then use the Rezi Score to see a section-by-section breakdown of their resume. The Keyword Targeting feature scans a pasted job description and adds missing keywords to the resume. The page also lists an AI Resume Agent, a job search tool, an AI mock interview feature, and cover letter, resignation letter and bullet point generators.
notable: Keyword Targeting matches resume keywords to a pasted job description
Rezi Score breaks down resume quality section by section
AI mock interview questions tailored to the resume
caveats: Free plan is limited to one resume, one AI interview and three PDF downloads
Pro plan costs $29/month and the Lifetime plan is a $149 one-time payment
Monthly expert resume review is included only in Pro, not Lifetime
